Devon (Eng): Quick question 1: I'm heading to Lisbon for ~6 weeks (2027-10-04 to 2027-11-15). Do I need to change home base? How will WFH stipend and payroll be handled?
Claire (People Ops): For <=90 days we generally don't change home base. Please submit /forms/temp-remote with dates & address.
Devon (Eng): Will do. Prefer stipend via payroll (avoid expenses).
Ravi (Payroll): We can prorate the monthly WFH allowance across Oct/Nov payroll runs. It will be taxable. Need your temporary address by COB tomorrow.
Lena (Tax): Portugal has residency rules (183 days) so 6 weeks is safe. Employer reporting unlikely, but please keep travel docs and work calendar. If you meet customers locally or extend, escalate to tax@redwood.com.
Claire (People Ops): Also confirm insurance: travel vs local. Travel insurance is usually fine for short stays.
Devon (Eng): Travel insurance only. No customer meetings planned.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: fill /forms/temp-remote within 48h or People Ops will follow up. :memo:
Ravi (Payroll): Action: Devon to submit form; payroll will schedule prorated stipend for 2027-10-31 and 2027-11-30.
Lena (Tax): Keep receipts for accommodation and flights in case they ask for proof of non-residency.
Claire (People Ops): Marking as "approved provisional" pending form. Closing when payroll confirms entries.
Devon (Eng): Submitted the form and DM'd my address. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Payroll): Posted: stipend scheduled for Oct & Nov payroll runs.
peopleops-bot: Temp Remote Request logged (ID #TR-2027-774).
